name: Kafr Al Sheikh
registryAssessment: The official Kafr El-Sheikh governorate portal documents a local spatial-services workflow and an interactive governorate map. The spatial service requires account login, and no anonymous public cadastral parcel response with a safe native ID and geometry was verified. Egypt's Survey Authority is the national mapping/cadastre custodian and documents cadastral, real-estate-registry, digital-map and topographic-map programs, but no anonymous city parcel-vector endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Kafr El Sheikh Egypt official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: Found the official Kafr El-Sheikh governorate interactive map, governorate spatial-services page, and Egyptian Survey Authority service/project pages. The governorate spatial service is an authenticated submission workflow; Survey Authority pages describe map/cadastre services and procurement, not an anonymous parcel API. No safe Kafr El-Sheikh parcel ID plus geometry response was verified.

queries.query: كفر الشيخ مصر خريطة كادسترية قطع الأراضي السجل العيني GIS
queries.result: Found the official governorate interactive map and المكاني spatial-services page, which describes geospatial property/building-position services but requires تسجيل الدخول. Egyptian Survey Authority Arabic pages document السجل العيني, الخرائط الرقمية, الخرائط الطبوغرافية, and Kafr El-Sheikh state-property GIS work; no anonymous parcel feature service or safe parcel geometry was found.

officialSources.role: Official Kafr El-Sheikh Governorate interactive map
officialSources.observation: Search/open discovery identifies a governorate interactive map with public place, project, service and investment points and Esri basemap attribution. The page timed out during a direct anonymous GET attempt; no parcel layer or parcel schema was verified.

officialSources.role: Official Kafr El-Sheikh Governorate spatial-services page
officialSources.observation: Describes digital property-positioning/spatial services and direct linkage to the spatial-variables center; the submission form explicitly requires login. It is local service/procedure evidence, not an open parcel-vector API.

officialSources.role: Egyptian Survey Authority official project/service portal
officialSources.observation: Lists the national urban real-estate-register project (السجل العيني), agricultural holding and property-inventory projects, and mapping services. No public anonymous parcel query endpoint is exposed in the page.

officialSources.role: Egyptian Survey Authority official digital-map service
officialSources.observation: States that digital GIS maps can be requested by location, scale, layers, format and projection through a paid/request workflow. This is not an anonymous downloadable parcel service.

officialSources.role: Egyptian Survey Authority official Kafr El-Sheikh state-property GIS announcement
officialSources.observation: Describes a digital unified state-property register based on GIS and survey-map metadata, including a Kafr El-Sheikh project phase; no public parcel response or native parcel identity was exposed.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The governorate spatial service is login-gated, the interactive-map direct request timed out, and Survey Authority map/cadastre pages describe request/procurement or program context rather than an open parcel endpoint. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point parcel test was claimed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kafr El-Sheikh governorate official interactive map and spatial-services portal, plus Egyptian Survey Authority official cadastral/real-estate-register, digital-map, topographic-map and Kafr El-Sheikh GIS materials.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local service existence and national custodian/program context were verified; citywide parcel-vector access, native parcel identity, parcel schema, parcel CRS response, and exact-point containment remain unverified.
